text:
maria: Quick sync — propose a 2-week stabilize mini-wave to tackle the highest-impact regressions + one low-risk enhancement. My suggested scope: pick the top 3 bugs (customer/regression prioritized) + 1 flaggable enhancement. agree?
sohail: +1 to 3 bugs + 1 enhancement behind a flag. Bugs Id push: embeddings p99 regression, streaming disconnects during bursts, and the recent rate-limit spike.
cassie: Telemetry: embeddings p99 spike hits ~7 orgs; 2 are paying enterprise and saw request timeouts. streaming disconnects are intermittent (burst windows), rate-limit errors correlate with a misrouted proxy rule.
alex: CS flagged one enterprise that would consider delaying new features until embeddings are stable. Embeddings fix likely means a model pin/rollback and a small runtime change — estimate ~3 dev-days.
maria: Proposed prioritization criteria we should use to pick items: 1) customer severity (revenue/SLA impact) 2) regression magnitude (p99/p50 deltas) 3) rollout complexity 4) undo/rollback cost. Use a simple score (high/med/low) and pick the top 3.
sohail: Workflow suggestion: triage -> owner assignment -> small canary -> monitor 48h -> full rollout. Enhancement shipped behind a feature flag. Owners should include rollback steps up-front.
emma: Design for prompt templating (the enhancement): default simple template + advanced toggle. Low friction flow; I can wireframe in 1 designer-day and handoff.
alex: Dependency check: embeddings model pin touches eng-runtime. @sam can you confirm how quickly we can add a temporary model-pin switch?
sam: I can add a model pin toggle in ~2 business days if we only change config. If we need cross-region routing changes add +1 day.
maria: Decision for this iteration: scope = 3 bugs + 1 flaggable enhancement. Tentative owners: sohail (embeddings p99), cassie (streaming disconnects), rachel (rate-limit spike), emma+alex (prompt templating). Milestone: PRs by end of next week, canary mid-week, full rollout after 48h of stable metrics.
sohail: I'll create a checklist on the sprint board and add explicit rollback steps: `revert model pin` and `disable feature flag`. Also adding smoke tests for embeddings to nightly.
sohail: Rollback commands for quick reference:
```
redwood runtime pin --unset model=embedding-v2
redwood feature-flag disable prompt_templating
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for #1739900000-emb-p99-fix on prod-1 at 2024-11-07T09:12:10Z :rocket:
cassie: I'll monitor infra alerts and have a playbook ready (runbook + on-call rotation for the canary window). Also adding a short health-check that runs every 10m during the canary.
maria: I'll update release notes and send an email to the 2 affected enterprise contacts tomorrow. If any customer wants a faster timeline we can escalate to sales for prioritization.
alex: Adding items to the roadmap sheet now and gating with customer acceptance in the ticket. cc: @rachel for rate-limit ownership.
rachel: got it — will start with the proxy rule rollback plan and split the fix into infra-safe steps.
maria: Great. Next steps: owners create draft PRs and assign reviewers by EOD Friday, canary target Tue-Wed, full rollout Thurs-Fri if no regressions. Ping this thread with the sprint board link when created.
sohail: will do. posting sprint card in 5m.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary completed (48h monitoring window started) — no regressions detected so far. :white_check_mark:
